name: Intent Reader
description: Fast one-line read of what {{user}}'s latest message is asking for, OOC asides included. Don't run it with: Beat Planner.
author: Purachina
prompt:
{{// Fast pre-generation note. One line, inserted just before the main model writes.}}{{trim}}
Read {{user}}'s latest message in the context. Write one plain line saying what {{user}} wants from the next reply: the action they are taking, the question they want answered, or where they want the scene to go.

If the message has an out-of-character request (in brackets, or after OOC), include it word for word.

Do not plan the reply or add ideas of your own. Write only the line.

preProcess.wrapPrefix: [What the user wants from this reply]
